import bpy
exec("""
# Remap the original grid monotonically around the first grass bank.
w=len(offsets)
assert len(terrain.data.vertices)==len(zs)*w
count=0
for j,z in enumerate(zs):
    if not 3<z<78:continue
    if pier_access(z)<2.1 or abs(z-65.2)<4.5:continue
    anchors=[(1.25,1.25),(2.75,first_edge(z)-.30),(3.0,first_edge(z)+.20),(5.25,5.25)]
    for i,d in enumerate(offsets):
        if not 1.25<d<5.25:continue
        for (a,aa),(b,bb) in zip(anchors,anchors[1:]):
            if a<=d<=b:
                nd=aa+(bb-aa)*(d-a)/(b-a);break
        v=terrain.data.vertices[j*w+i];x=shore(z)+nd
        v.co.x=x;v.co.z=land(x,z);count+=1
terrain.data.update();bpy.context.view_layer.update()
terrain.data.calc_loop_triangles()
folded=[]
for t in terrain.data.loop_triangles:
    a,b,c=[terrain.data.vertices[i].co for i in t.vertices]
    if (b-a).cross(c-a).z<=0:folded.append(t.index)
assert not folded,folded[:20]
ground_bvh=BVHTree.FromObject(terrain,bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get())
report={'remapped_vertices':count,'inverted_triangles':len(folded),'terrain_triangles':len(terrain.data.loop_triangles)}
(LOG/'contour_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print(report)
export_collection('Reference_Terrain','terrain.glb')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
""",bpy.app.driver_namespace['space20'])
